cost_scope: unit build/reload cost; not wall clock

finance_gate.criterion: every unique HR-selected deployable adaptation must leave frontier >=5% better in both Finance mean completion pages and unit-cost, with no adaptation Pareto dominance
finance_gate.paper_action: downgrade/stop beat-CaGR claim: no adaptation passed the HR deployment constraints

mandatory_interpretation: this stress test overrides the weaker faithful-theta gate for any paper claim that ReprForge beats CaGR-style deployment adaptations

selection.criterion: minimize HR burst/Poisson mean of 0.5*completion/FIFO + 0.5*unit-cost/FIFO among singleton<=50%, utilization>=50% candidates; the lower-theta deployment selection excludes the faithful theta=0.5 anchor
